content.title: Grab Hails Mapping Tech as Promising Revenue Driver
content.summary: Ride-hailing firm  Grab Holdings  is getting ready to map out Mongolia using its in-house technology, which the company is increasingly seeing as a new avenue of revenue growth.  Nasdaq-listed Grab, which operates a superapp offering rides, delivery and other services, is teaming up with a Mongolian company to map out the landlocked Asian country.  The project is Grab’s first countrywide mapmaking effort outside of Southeast Asia, the region where the company’s app is most widely used.
